subject: english
label: 中学英語 並べ替え
blurb: ばらばらの語を正しい順に並べて英文を打つ。疑問文・副詞・比較の語順
audience: 中学生、語順に自信がない大人

genres.wo-object: 目的語・場所・時の順
genres.wo-relative: 関係代名詞・後置修飾

words.answer: Do you like music?
words.q: あなたは音楽が好きですか。（Do で始めて）
words.explain: 一般動詞の疑問文は Do＋主語＋動詞の原形。Are you like のように be動詞を混ぜない
words.say: Do you like music?

words.answer: Does she play the piano?
words.q: 彼女はピアノを弾きますか。（Does で始めて）
words.explain: 主語が三人称単数なら Does＋主語＋原形。Does she plays と s を残すのが定番の誤り
words.say: Does she play the piano?

words.answer: What time do you get up?
words.q: あなたは何時に起きますか。（What time で始めて）
words.explain: 疑問詞が文頭、その後ろは do you get up の疑問文の語順。疑問詞のあとを肯定文の順にしない
words.say: What time do you get up?

words.answer: Where did you go yesterday?
words.q: あなたは昨日どこへ行きましたか。（Where で始めて）
words.explain: Where＋did＋主語＋原形。did があるので go は原形のまま。yesterday は文末
words.say: Where did you go yesterday?

words.answer: How many books does he have?
words.q: 彼は本を何冊持っていますか。（How many で始めて）
words.explain: How many＋複数名詞をひとかたまりで文頭に置き、そのあと does he have。books を文末に残さない
words.say: How many books does he have?

words.answer: What are you doing now?
words.q: あなたは今何をしているのですか。（What で始めて）
words.explain: 疑問詞＋be動詞＋主語＋動詞ing。What you are doing は間接疑問の語順で、疑問文としては誤り
words.say: What are you doing now?

words.answer: Why were you late this morning?
words.q: あなたは今朝なぜ遅れたのですか。（Why で始めて）
words.explain: be動詞の疑問文は be動詞を主語の前に出すだけ。Why did you late のように did を使わない
words.say: Why were you late this morning?

words.answer: What sport do you like the best?
words.q: あなたはどんなスポーツがいちばん好きですか。
words.explain: What sport をひとかたまりで文頭に。the best は文末。What do you like sport とは言わない
words.say: What sport do you like the best?

words.answer: How long have you lived in Tokyo?
words.ja: 現在完了の疑問文（期間）
words.q: あなたはどのくらい東京に住んでいますか。（How long で始めて）
words.explain: How long＋have＋主語＋過去分詞。期間をたずねる現在完了。in Tokyo は文末
words.say: How long have you lived in Tokyo?

words.answer: How often does your father cook dinner?
words.q: あなたのお父さんはどのくらいの頻度で夕食を作りますか。
words.explain: 頻度は How often。主語 your father は三人称単数なので does、cook は原形
words.say: How often does your father cook dinner?

words.answer: I do not like carrots.
accept: I don't like carrots.
words.q: 私はにんじんが好きではありません。
words.explain: 一般動詞の否定は do not＋原形を動詞の前に。I am not like や I not like は誤り
words.say: I do not like carrots.

words.answer: She does not eat breakfast.
accept: She doesn't eat breakfast.
words.q: 彼女は朝食を食べません。（does を使って）
words.explain: 三人称単数の否定は does not＋原形。s は does が引き受けるので eats にしない
words.say: She does not eat breakfast.

words.answer: I am not a student.
accept: I'm not a student.
words.q: 私は学生ではありません。（am を使って）
words.explain: be動詞の否定は be動詞のすぐ後ろに not。冠詞 a を忘れない
words.say: I am not a student.

words.answer: He did not come to the party.
accept: He didn't come to the party.
words.q: 彼はそのパーティーに来ませんでした。
words.explain: 過去の否定は did not＋原形。did not came と動詞まで過去形にしない
words.say: He did not come to the party.

words.answer: We are not going to swim in the sea.
accept: We aren't going to swim in the sea.
words.ja: be going to の否定文
words.q: 私たちは海で泳ぐつもりはありません。
words.explain: be going to の否定は be動詞の後ろに not。場所 in the sea は文末
words.say: We are not going to swim in the sea.

words.answer: You must not run here.
accept: You mustn't run here.
words.q: ここで走ってはいけません。（must を使って）
words.explain: 助動詞の否定は助動詞＋not＋原形。must not は「禁止」、don't have to は「しなくてよい」
words.say: You must not run here.

words.answer: I have not finished my homework yet.
accept: I haven't finished my homework yet.
words.q: 私はまだ宿題を終えていません。
words.explain: have not＋過去分詞。否定文の「まだ」yet は文末。already は否定文で使わない
words.say: I have not finished my homework yet.

words.answer: There is not any milk in the box.
accept: There isn't any milk in the box.
words.q: その箱の中に牛乳は少しもありません。（any を使って）
words.explain: There is not any ＝ There is no。否定文では some ではなく any を使う
words.say: There is not any milk in the box.

words.answer: She was not able to swim well.
accept: She wasn't able to swim well.
words.ja: be able to の否定文
words.q: 彼女は上手に泳ぐことができませんでした。（able を使って）
words.explain: be able to の否定は be動詞の後ろに not。副詞 well は動詞の後ろ、文末に置く
words.say: She was not able to swim well.

words.answer: I do not know why he was angry.
accept: I don't know why he was angry.
words.q: 私は彼がなぜ怒っていたのか知りません。
words.explain: know の後ろの疑問詞節は why＋主語＋動詞の肯定文の語順。why was he としない
words.say: I do not know why he was angry.

words.answer: I always get up at six.
words.ja: 頻度副詞の位置（一般動詞）
words.q: 私はいつも6時に起きます。（always を使って）
words.explain: always などの頻度副詞は一般動詞の前。時刻 at six は文末
words.say: I always get up at six.

words.answer: She usually walks to school.
words.ja: 頻度副詞の位置（三単現）
words.q: 彼女はふだん歩いて学校へ行きます。（usually を使って）
words.explain: usually は一般動詞 walks の前。walks to school で「歩いて学校へ行く」
words.say: She usually walks to school.

words.answer: He is always kind to me.
accept: He's always kind to me.
words.q: 彼はいつも私に親切です。（always を使って）
words.explain: be動詞のときは頻度副詞を be動詞の後ろに。一般動詞の前・be動詞の後ろ、と覚える
words.say: He is always kind to me.

words.answer: We often play soccer together.
words.q: 私たちはよくいっしょにサッカーをします。
words.explain: often は動詞 play の前。together は文末。We play often soccer とはしない
words.say: We often play soccer together.

words.answer: My father never drinks coffee.
words.q: 私の父はけっしてコーヒーを飲みません。（never を使って）
words.explain: never は「一度も〜ない」で、それ自体が否定。not は不要で、動詞の前に置く
words.say: My father never drinks coffee.

words.answer: She is usually very busy.
accept: She's usually very busy.
words.q: 彼女はたいていとても忙しいです。（usually を使って）
words.explain: be動詞の後ろに usually、そのあと very busy。very は形容詞の直前
words.say: She is usually very busy.

words.answer: Do you usually study English at home?
words.ja: 疑問文の中の頻度副詞
words.q: あなたはふだん家で英語を勉強しますか。（usually を使って）
words.explain: 疑問文では頻度副詞は主語の後ろ、動詞の前。場所 at home は文末
words.say: Do you usually study English at home?

words.answer: He can swim very well.
words.q: 彼はとても上手に泳ぐことができます。
words.explain: well のような様態の副詞は動詞の後ろ（文末）。very は well の直前。He can very well swim は誤り
words.say: He can swim very well.

words.answer: My mother always tells me to study hard.
words.q: 母はいつも私に一生懸命勉強しなさいと言います。
words.explain: always は tells の前。tell＋人＋to＋動詞の順。hard は文末で「一生懸命に」
words.say: My mother always tells me to study hard.

words.answer: He does not usually watch TV.
accept: He doesn't usually watch TV.
words.ja: 否定文の中の頻度副詞
words.q: 彼はふだんテレビを見ません。（usually を使って）
words.explain: 否定文では does not の後ろに usually、そのあと動詞。does usually not は不自然
words.say: He does not usually watch TV.

words.answer: I play tennis in the park on Sundays.
accept: On Sundays I play tennis in the park.
words.q: 私は日曜日に公園でテニスをします。
words.explain: 英語は 動詞＋目的語＋場所＋時 の順。日本語の「日曜日に公園で」の順のまま並べない
words.say: I play tennis in the park on Sundays.

words.answer: There is a cat under the table.
accept: There's a cat under the table.
words.q: テーブルの下に猫が1匹います。
words.explain: There is＋名詞＋場所の順。日本語の「テーブルの下に」を先に置かない
words.say: There is a cat under the table.

words.answer: There are two dogs in the garden.
words.q: 庭に犬が2匹います。（There で始めて）
words.explain: 複数名詞には There are。数＋名詞（two dogs）をひとかたまりに、場所は文末
words.say: There are two dogs in the garden.

words.answer: I gave him a present.
words.q: 私は彼にプレゼントをあげました。（to を使わずに）
words.explain: give＋人＋物 の順。人と物を逆にするなら I gave a present to him と to が必要
words.say: I gave him a present.

words.answer: He showed the picture to his friends.
words.q: 彼はその写真を友達に見せました。（to を使って）
words.explain: show＋物＋to＋人 の順。to があるときは物が先。He showed to his friends the picture は誤り
words.say: He showed the picture to his friends.

words.answer: My mother made me a big cake.
words.q: 母は私に大きなケーキを作ってくれました。
words.explain: make＋人＋物 の順。形容詞 big は名詞 cake の直前。a big cake のかたまりを崩さない
words.say: My mother made me a big cake.

words.answer: I bought a new bike for my brother.
words.q: 私は弟に新しい自転車を買いました。（for を使って）
words.explain: buy は物＋for＋人。give・show は to、buy・make は for と組み合わせる
words.say: I bought a new bike for my brother.

words.answer: Please tell me your name.
accept: Tell me your name, please.
words.q: あなたの名前を私に教えてください。
words.explain: tell＋人＋物 の順。「教える」は teach ではなく tell。Please は文頭か文末
words.say: Please tell me your name.

words.answer: Ken went to Kyoto with his family last summer.
accept: Last summer Ken went to Kyoto with his family.
words.q: ケンは去年の夏、家族と京都へ行きました。
words.explain: 場所（to Kyoto）→だれと（with his family）→いつ（last summer）の順。時は文末か文頭
words.say: Ken went to Kyoto with his family last summer.

words.answer: There were a lot of people at the station.
words.q: 駅にはたくさんの人がいました。
words.explain: a lot of people は複数なので There were。場所は文末。people に s は付けない
words.say: There were a lot of people at the station.

words.answer: I want to be a doctor.
words.q: 私は医者になりたいです。（be を使って）
words.explain: want to＋原形。「〜になる」は be でよい。冠詞 a を忘れない
words.say: I want to be a doctor.

words.answer: I like to play the guitar.
words.q: 私はギターを弾くのが好きです。（to を使って）
words.explain: like to＋原形。楽器には the を付ける（play the guitar）。スポーツには付けない
words.say: I like to play the guitar.

words.answer: Playing soccer is fun.
words.q: サッカーをすることは楽しいです。（Playing で始めて）
words.explain: 動名詞のかたまり Playing soccer が主語で三人称単数扱い。動詞は is
words.say: Playing soccer is fun.

words.answer: He wants to go to Kyoto.
words.q: 彼は京都へ行きたがっています。
words.explain: wants to go to Kyoto と to が2つ続く。1つ目は不定詞の to、2つ目は「〜へ」の前置詞
words.say: He wants to go to Kyoto.

words.answer: I went to the library to study.
words.ja: 不定詞（副詞的用法・目的）
words.q: 私は勉強するために図書館へ行きました。
words.explain: 「〜するために」の to＋原形は文末。went to the library のあとに to study
words.say: I went to the library to study.

words.answer: Thank you for helping me.
words.q: 手伝ってくれてありがとう。（for を使って）
words.explain: 前置詞 for の後ろは動名詞。Thank you for to help は誤り
words.say: Thank you for helping me.

words.answer: I have no time to watch TV.
words.q: 私にはテレビを見る時間がありません。（no を使って）
words.explain: 「〜する時間」は time to＋原形で、不定詞が名詞の後ろから修飾する
words.say: I have no time to watch TV.

words.answer: My dream is to be a singer.
words.q: 私の夢は歌手になることです。（to を使って）
words.explain: 主語 My dream＋is＋to be a singer。be動詞の後ろに不定詞のかたまりを置く
words.say: My dream is to be a singer.

words.answer: It is difficult for me to speak English.
accept: It's difficult for me to speak English.
words.q: 私にとって英語を話すことは難しいです。（It で始めて）
words.explain: It is＋形容詞＋for＋人＋to＋原形。for me は to の前に置く。to speak for me は誤り
words.say: It is difficult for me to speak English.

words.answer: He was too tired to walk.
words.q: 彼は疲れすぎて歩けませんでした。（too を使って）
words.explain: too＋形容詞＋to＋原形で「〜すぎて…できない」。not は使わない
words.say: He was too tired to walk.

words.answer: I am taller than my brother.
accept: I'm taller than my brother.
words.q: 私は兄より背が高いです。（than を使って）
words.explain: be動詞＋比較級＋than＋比べる相手。more taller と重ねない
words.say: I am taller than my brother.

words.answer: This book is more interesting than that one.
words.q: この本はあの本よりおもしろいです。（one を使って）
words.explain: 長い形容詞は more＋原級。that one の one は book の繰り返しを避ける代名詞
words.say: This book is more interesting than that one.

words.answer: Ken is the tallest in his class.
words.q: ケンはクラスでいちばん背が高いです。
words.explain: 最上級には the。範囲は「集団・場所」なら in、「同類の複数」なら of
words.say: Ken is the tallest in his class.

words.answer: She runs faster than Mike.
words.q: 彼女はマイクより速く走ります。
words.explain: 副詞 fast の比較級 faster は動詞 runs の後ろ。She faster runs は誤り
words.say: She runs faster than Mike.

words.answer: This is the most beautiful picture of all.
words.q: これは全部の中でいちばん美しい絵です。
words.explain: the most＋形容詞＋名詞 のかたまり。of all は文末。the most picture beautiful は誤り
words.say: This is the most beautiful picture of all.

words.answer: I like summer better than winter.
words.q: 私は冬より夏の方が好きです。（better を使って）
words.explain: like＋好きな方＋better than＋比べる方。日本語の「冬より」が先でも英語は summer が先
words.say: I like summer better than winter.

words.answer: He is as tall as his father.
accept: He's as tall as his father.
words.q: 彼はお父さんと同じくらいの背の高さです。
words.explain: as＋原級＋as。間に入るのは taller ではなく tall。2つ目の as の後ろに相手
words.say: He is as tall as his father.

words.answer: Tokyo is the biggest city in Japan.
words.q: 東京は日本でいちばん大きな都市です。
words.explain: the biggest city をひとかたまりに、範囲 in Japan は文末。of Japan とはしない
words.say: Tokyo is the biggest city in Japan.

words.answer: I cannot swim as fast as Ken.
accept: I can't swim as fast as Ken.
words.q: 私はケンほど速く泳げません。（as を使って）
words.explain: not as … as で「〜ほど…ない」。as fast as は動詞 swim の後ろにまとめて置く
words.say: I cannot swim as fast as Ken.

words.answer: Nothing is more important than time.
words.q: 時間ほど大切なものはありません。（Nothing で始めて）
words.explain: Nothing is＋比較級＋than で最上級と同じ意味。Nothing が主語なので not は不要
words.say: Nothing is more important than time.

words.answer: I was watching TV when he called me.
accept: When he called me, I was watching TV.
words.q: 彼が私に電話をくれたとき、私はテレビを見ていました。
words.explain: when＋主語＋動詞 のかたまりは文末でも文頭でもよい。文頭に置くときはコンマで区切る
words.say: I was watching TV when he called me.

words.answer: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
accept: I will stay home if it rains tomorrow.
If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay home.
I'll stay home if it rains tomorrow.
words.q: もし明日雨が降ったら、私は家にいます。
words.explain: 条件の if 節は未来のことでも現在形（rains）。will は主節にだけ付ける
words.say: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.

words.answer: I think that he is right.
accept: I think that he's right.
words.q: 私は彼が正しいと思います。（that を使って）
words.explain: I think の後ろに that＋主語＋動詞。日本語と逆で「思う」が先、内容が後
words.say: I think that he is right.

words.answer: I know that she likes music.
words.q: 私は彼女が音楽を好きだということを知っています。
words.explain: know that＋文。that 節の中は肯定文の語順で、主語 she に合わせて likes
words.say: I know that she likes music.

words.answer: I know where he lives.
words.q: 私は彼がどこに住んでいるか知っています。
words.explain: 疑問詞の後ろは 主語＋動詞 の肯定文の語順。where does he live のまま入れない
words.say: I know where he lives.

words.answer: Do you know what this is?
words.q: あなたはこれが何か知っていますか。
words.explain: 文全体は Do you know の疑問文、中の what this is は肯定文の語順。what is this にしない
words.say: Do you know what this is?

words.answer: I stayed home because I was sick.
accept: Because I was sick, I stayed home.
words.q: 私は病気だったので家にいました。
words.explain: because＋理由 は文末が基本。文頭に置くなら結果の文まで続ける（Because … , I stayed home）
words.say: I stayed home because I was sick.

words.answer: She was happy when she heard the news.
accept: When she heard the news, she was happy.
words.q: その知らせを聞いたとき、彼女はうれしかったです。
words.explain: when 節の中も過去形（heard）。主節と従属節の時制をそろえる
words.say: She was happy when she heard the news.

words.answer: Please tell me when the train will leave.
accept: Tell me when the train will leave, please.
words.q: その電車がいつ出発するか私に教えてください。
words.explain: tell＋人＋疑問詞節。「いつ〜か」の名詞節では will を使ってよい（条件・時の副詞節とは違う）
words.say: Please tell me when the train will leave.

words.answer: I do not know who that man is.
accept: I don't know who that man is.
words.q: 私はあの男性がだれなのか知りません。
words.explain: who の後ろは that man is の順。be動詞は主語の後ろに戻す。who is that man は誤り
words.say: I do not know who that man is.

words.answer: I have a friend who lives in Tokyo.
words.q: 私には東京に住んでいる友達がいます。
words.explain: 名詞 a friend の後ろに who＋動詞。日本語は「住んでいる友達」と前から修飾するが英語は後ろから
words.say: I have a friend who lives in Tokyo.

words.answer: This is the book that I bought yesterday.
words.ja: 関係代名詞 that（目的格）
words.q: これは私が昨日買った本です。（that を使って）
words.explain: the book の後ろに that＋主語＋動詞。bought の後ろに it を置かない
words.say: This is the book that I bought yesterday.

words.answer: I know the boy playing soccer over there.
words.q: 私は向こうでサッカーをしている少年を知っています。
words.explain: playing soccer over there が the boy を後ろから修飾。1語なら前、2語以上なら後ろ
words.say: I know the boy playing soccer over there.

words.answer: This is a picture taken by my father.
words.q: これは父によって撮られた写真です。
words.explain: taken by my father が a picture を後ろから修飾。「撮られた」は過去分詞 taken
words.say: This is a picture taken by my father.

words.answer: Do you know the man who is talking with Emi?
words.ja: 疑問文＋関係代名詞 who
words.q: あなたはエミと話している男性を知っていますか。
words.explain: the man の直後に who is talking with Emi。関係詞節は修飾する名詞のすぐ後ろに置く
words.say: Do you know the man who is talking with Emi?

words.answer: The cake made by Emi was very good.
words.ja: 主語を修飾する過去分詞
words.q: エミが作ったケーキはとてもおいしかったです。（made を使って）
words.explain: 主語 The cake made by Emi のかたまりの後に動詞 was。主語が長くても動詞を忘れない
words.say: The cake made by Emi was very good.

words.answer: The book I read last night was interesting.
words.ja: 関係代名詞の省略（接触節）
words.q: 私が昨夜読んだ本はおもしろかったです。（that を使わずに）
words.explain: The book の直後に I read last night（主語＋動詞）を置いて修飾。目的格の関係代名詞は省略できる
words.say: The book I read last night was interesting.

words.answer: I want a house which has a big garden.
words.q: 私は大きな庭のある家がほしいです。（which を使って）
words.explain: 物には which。a house の後ろに which has a big garden。has は先行詞 a house に合わせる
words.say: I want a house which has a big garden.

words.answer: The boy I met at the station was very kind.
words.q: 私が駅で会った少年はとても親切でした。
words.explain: The boy I met at the station が主語。文の動詞 was はそのかたまりの後ろ
words.say: The boy I met at the station was very kind.

words.answer: Is this the bus that goes to the station?
words.ja: 疑問文＋関係代名詞 that
words.q: これは駅へ行くバスですか。（that を使って）
words.explain: Is this the bus の後ろに that goes to the station。goes は先行詞 the bus に合わせて s
words.say: Is this the bus that goes to the station?

words.answer: This picture was painted by Emi.
words.q: この絵はエミによって描かれました。
words.explain: be動詞＋過去分詞＋by＋人。by は「〜によって」で文末。was painted の順を崩さない
words.say: This picture was painted by Emi.

words.answer: English is spoken in many countries.
words.q: 英語は多くの国で話されています。
words.explain: 行為者が一般の人なら by は省略。is spoken＋場所。in many countries は文末
words.say: English is spoken in many countries.

words.answer: I have already finished my homework.
accept: I have finished my homework already.
I've already finished my homework.
I've finished my homework already.
words.q: 私はもう宿題を終えました。（already を使って）
words.explain: already は have と過去分詞の間が基本。文末に置くこともできる
words.say: I have already finished my homework.

words.answer: I have never seen a panda.
accept: I've never seen a panda.
words.q: 私はパンダを一度も見たことがありません。
words.explain: never は have と過去分詞の間。「見たことがない」は have never seen で not は不要
words.say: I have never seen a panda.

words.answer: Was this book written by Ken?
words.q: この本はケンによって書かれたのですか。
words.explain: 受け身の疑問文は be動詞を文頭に。Was＋主語＋過去分詞＋by。Did を使わない
words.say: Was this book written by Ken?

words.answer: These cars are made in Japan.
words.q: これらの車は日本で作られています。
words.explain: 主語が複数なので are made。「日本製」は made in Japan で by ではなく in
words.say: These cars are made in Japan.

words.answer: Have you ever been to Kyoto?
words.q: あなたは今までに京都へ行ったことがありますか。
words.explain: Have＋主語＋ever＋過去分詞。ever は主語と過去分詞の間。「行ったことがある」は been to
words.say: Have you ever been to Kyoto?

words.answer: She has not come home yet.
accept: She hasn't come home yet.
words.q: 彼女はまだ家に帰ってきていません。
words.explain: has not＋過去分詞、「まだ」の yet は文末。come home に to は不要
words.say: She has not come home yet.

words.answer: I have been busy since last week.
accept: Since last week I have been busy.
I've been busy since last week.
words.q: 私は先週からずっと忙しいです。
words.explain: have been＋形容詞＋since＋起点。「〜から」は since、「〜の間」は for
words.say: I have been busy since last week.

words.answer: How long have you been studying English?
words.ja: 現在完了進行形の疑問文
words.q: あなたはどのくらいの間、英語を勉強し続けていますか。
words.explain: How long＋have＋主語＋been＋動詞ing。been と studying の順を入れ替えない
words.say: How long have you been studying English?

words.answer: The news made me happy.
words.q: その知らせは私をうれしくさせました。
words.explain: make＋人＋形容詞 の順。made happy me は誤り。「人＝状態」の関係になる
words.say: The news made me happy.

words.answer: We call him Ken.
words.q: 私たちは彼をケンと呼びます。（call を使って）
words.explain: call＋人＋呼び名 の順。call Ken him は誤り。「彼＝ケン」の関係
words.say: We call him Ken.

words.answer: What a big dog this is!
words.q: これはなんて大きな犬なのでしょう。（What で始めて）
words.explain: What＋a＋形容詞＋名詞＋主語＋動詞。文末は主語＋動詞の順で、疑問文の語順にしない
words.say: What a big dog this is!

words.answer: How kind you are!
words.q: あなたはなんて親切なのでしょう。（How で始めて）
words.explain: How＋形容詞＋主語＋動詞。名詞がないときは How。How are you kind は疑問文になってしまう
words.say: How kind you are!

words.answer: You like music, don't you?
words.q: あなたは音楽が好きですよね。（付加疑問で）
words.explain: 肯定文には否定の付加疑問 don't you? を文末に。主語は代名詞で繰り返す
words.say: You like music, don't you?

words.answer: My friends call me Emi.
words.q: 私の友達は私をエミと呼びます。（call を使って）
words.explain: 主語 My friends＋call＋me＋Emi。目的語 me は動詞の直後、呼び名はその後ろ
words.say: My friends call me Emi.

words.answer: She looks very happy.
words.q: 彼女はとても幸せそうに見えます。
words.explain: look＋形容詞で「〜に見える」。looks like happy と like を入れない（like の後ろは名詞）
words.say: She looks very happy.

words.answer: This song always makes me happy.
words.q: この歌はいつも私を幸せな気持ちにします。
words.explain: always は動詞 makes の前。makes＋me＋happy の順。主語が物でも make＋人＋形容詞は使える
words.say: This song always makes me happy.

words.answer: It is not cold today, is it?
accept: It isn't cold today, is it?
words.q: 今日は寒くないですよね。（付加疑問で）
words.explain: 否定文には肯定の付加疑問 is it? を付ける。isn't it? としない
words.say: It is not cold today, is it?

words.answer: What an interesting story he told!
words.q: 彼はなんておもしろい話をしたのでしょう。（What で始めて）
words.explain: What＋an＋形容詞＋名詞 が told の目的語。母音で始まる interesting には an
words.say: What an interesting story he told!
